messages:
elaine (partnerships): heads up — Nimbus Cloud procurement just sent back the marketplace onboarding packet with a bunch of redlines. they want to force their marketplace terms (60d net invoicing), require EDI PO flow, and insist on a separate SOW for listing. they’re refusing to sign our MSA unless we accept their rev-share + payment flow. need advice on defensible positions before i reply. :eyes:
sanjay (sales): yikes. i’ll loop in CRO but we need a quick decision on net terms. can we accept 60d for marketplace channel deals if it's the only way to get this listing?
lisa (legal): can you drop their redline here (pdf/link)? we typically push back on marketplace-imposed msas because they create downstream obligations. if they insist on 60d, we can propose a compromise: 45d net for marketplace with an invoice acceptance clause and an SLA credit if they delay. also: we should not sign a separate SOW that materially changes revenue recognition without finance sign-off.
mike (finance): 60d net is a non-starter for standard commercial terms — cashflow risk. for strategic listings we can approve 45d with treasury sign-off and a short-term credit facility. need expected ARR from listing to justify. can @sanjay share expected monthly new ARR estimate?
rohit (marketplace-ops): for Nimbus their onboarding requires either EDI PO or their manual marketplace purchase portal. EDI can take 10 business days to set up, so that will block go-live. also they require a vendor tax form (W-9/W-8) and GNID for their listing team. if we can accept 45d and agree to their rev-share mechanics (with clear reporting cadence), ops can fast-track the listing once legal and finance align.
elaine (partnerships): attaching their redline: https://files.nimbus.example/redlines-2026-11-05.pdf — highlights: clause 5.2 (marketplace billing) swapped our net30 to net60, clause 9 (data residency) adds vendor audit rights, clause 12 (indemnity) expands to customer downstream.
lisa (legal): thx. quick take: push back on unlimited downstream indemnity, carve out audits to scheduled & scoped, and cap liability for marketplace listing activities. i'll prepare a redline accepting rev-share math but striking net60. propose language: `Net terms: 45 days from invoice date; in the event of late payment, partner may apply interest of 1.5%/month.`
mike (finance): if we accept 45d we need PO automation to attach PO numbers to invoices. sample PO format they provided looks like: `PO-NU-2026-12345 | ITEM: LISTING_FEE | AMT: $X`. we need ops to confirm invoice mapping works. @rohit can your team add PO field to invoice metadata?
rohit (marketplace-ops): yes we can add a `marketplace_po` metadata field — should be a small config. timeline: 3 biz days once redline accepted. EDI still optional but recommended for scale.
sanjay (sales): i'll ask CRO to approve 45d as a one-off if projected incremental ARR > $20k/mo. tagging @ceo for visibility in the thread. we should offer Nimbus a limited pilot: 90 day trial with milestone-based payment triggers to mitigate cashflow.
elaine (partnerships): plan: lisa will send counter-redline today (accept rev-share math, 45d net, indemnity cap + scoped audits), mike and treasury will sign-off on 45d if ARR target is met, rohit will prep PO metadata and onboarding checklist. aiming for signed counter + PO flow by Friday EOD. everyone ok? :thumbsup:
lisa (legal): ok — i'll upload counter redline to the doc and ping Nimbus legal.
mike (finance): approve conditional on ARR estimate. send numbers.
vendor-bot: Nimbus Marketplace — onboarding packet received (ticket #NM-9482). current status: awaiting vendor counter.
